# process_UTR_barcodes.R

## process_UTR_barcodes()

```{r}
process_UTR_barcodes(source_dir = "data/testing",
                     sample_name = "MB_barcoded",
                     UTR_barcode_AmpID = "AMPL902654",
                     min_reads = 2,
                     seq_before_barcode_1 = "GTACGAAGACTG",
                     seq_before_barcode_2 = "CGATACTTGTTCGATCCTTCGC",
                     seq_after_barcode_3 = "CTTGTCTCGCTCCGGG",
                     output_dir = "data/testing",
                     verbose = TRUE) 
```

# identify_whitelisted_barcodes.R

## identify_whitelisted_barcodes()

```{r}
identify_whitelisted_barcodes(source_dir = "data/testing",
                              BC1_whitelist_file_name = "75K_barcode.csv",
                              BC2_BC3_whitelist_file_name = "Wong_barcode_pairs.csv",
                              cell_to_extracted_BCs_file_name = "cell_to_extracted_BCs.rds",
                              output_dir = "data/testing",
                              verbose = TRUE)
```


# barcodes_QC_plots.R

## barcodes_QC_plots()

```{r}
barcodes_QC_plots(source_dir = "data/testing",
                  list_BC1_file_name = "list_BC1.rds",
                  list_BC2_3_file_name = "list_BC2_3.rds",
                  output_dir = "plots",
                  verbose = TRUE)
```

# assign_UTR_barcodes.R

## assign_UTR_barcodes()

```{r}
assign_UTR_barcodes(source_dir = "data/testing",
                    BC_thresholds = list(BC1_threshold = 3, BC2_3_threshold = 5),
                    reads_thresholds = list(min_reads = 5, min_reads_proportion = 0.9),
                    output_dir = "data/testing",
                    verbose = TRUE)
```

# summarise_variants.R

## summarise_variants()

```{r}
summarise_variants(source_dir = "data/testing",
                   sample_name = "MB_barcoded",
                   panel_ID = "6915",
                   output_dir = "data/testing",
                   verbose = TRUE)
```
